usedFor: Shopify tracks checkouts and orders, and Desklog.io holds the follow-up work when “Order Cancelled” runs “Create Task”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Create Task” in Desklog.io
bestTemplate.why: A cancelled order becomes a task someone owns, so the reason gets looked at.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” is polling, so a task from it appears after a scheduled check.
